methods.what: Derivative relation for the AGM M(1+x,1-x)
Linear combinations of two solutions P, Q of a second-order linear ODE
Reduction of linear second-order ODE to Riccati equation via logarithmic derivative
Riccati equation obtained from the AGM differential equation (x^3-x)y''+(3x^2-1)y'+xy=0
Shift substitution removing the linear term of the Riccati equation, yielding a normal form
Differential equation in the angle variable φ
Wronskian-type relation in φ set equal to π
